transliteration: al-lahum-ma yaa malaad'al-laaa-id'een
english_text: O God, O Shelter of the shelter-seekers!

arabic_text: وَيا مَعاذَ الْعائِذِينَ، وَيا مُنْجِيَ الْهالِكِينَ،
transliteration: wa yaa maa'ad'al-a'aa-id'eena wa yaa munjeeal-haalikeen
english_text: O Refuge of the refuge-seekers! O Deliverer of the perishing!

arabic_text: وَيا عاصِمَ الْبائِسِينَ، وَيا راحِمَ الْمَساكِينِ،
transliteration: wa yaa a'as'imal-baaa-iseen wa yaa raah'imal-masaakeen
english_text: O Preserver of the pitiful! O Merciful toward the miserable!

arabic_text: وَيا مُجِيبَ الْمُضْطَرِّينَ، وَيا كَنْزَ الْمُفْتَقِرِينَ
transliteration: wa yaa mujeebal-muz''-t'ar-reen wa yaa kanzal-muf-taqireen
english_text: O Responder to the distressed! O Treasure of the utterly poor!

transliteration: wa yaa jaabiral-munkasireen
english_text: O Mender of the broken!

transliteration: wa yaa maa-waal-munqat'ie'en
english_text: O Haven of the cut off!

transliteration: wa yaa naas'iral-mus-taz''-a'feen
english_text: O Helper of the abased!

transliteration: wa yaa mujeeral-khaaa-ifeen
english_text: O Granter of sanctuary to the fearful!

transliteration: wa yaa mugheethal-mak-roobeen
english_text: O Aider of the troubled!

transliteration: wa yaa h'is'-nal-laajeen
english_text: O Fortress of the refugees!

arabic_text: إِنْ لَمْ أَعُذْ بِعِزَّتِكَ فَبِمَنْ أَعُوذُ؟
transliteration: il-lam au'd' bii'z-zatika fabiman au'wd'
english_text: If I seek not refuge in Your might, in whom shall I seek refuge?

arabic_text: وَإِنْ لَمْ أَلُذْ بِقُدْرَتِكَ فَبِمَنْ أَلُوذُ؟
transliteration: wa il-lam alud' biqud-ratika fabiman alood'
english_text: If I seek not shelter in Your power, in whom shall I seek shelter?

arabic_text: وَقَدْ أَلْجَأَتْنِي الذُّنُوبُ إِلَىٰ التَّشَبُّثِ بِأَذْيالِ عَفْوِكَ،
transliteration: wa qad al-jaat-need'-d'unoobu ilaat-tashab-buthi bid'-yaali a'f-wik
english_text: Sins have made me seek asylum in laying hold on the skirts of Your pardon,

arabic_text: وَأَحْوَجَتْنِي الْخَطايا إِلَىٰ اسْتِفْتَاحِ أَبْوَابِ صَفْحِكَ،
transliteration: wa ah'-wajat-neel-khat'aayaaa ilaa as-tif-taahee ab-waabi s'af-h'ik
english_text: offenses have compelled me to beg the opening of the doors of Your forgiveness,

arabic_text: وَدَعَتْنِي الإِساءَةُ إِلَىٰ الإِنَاخَةِ بِفِنَاءِ عِزِّكَ،
transliteration: wa daa't-neel-isaaa-atu ilaal-inaakhati bifinaaa-i i'z-zik
english_text: evildoing has summoned me to dismount in the courtyard of Your might,

arabic_text: وَحَمَلَتْنِي الْمَخافَةُ مِنْ نِقْمَتِكَ عَلَىٰ التَّمَسُّكِ بِعُرْوَةِ عَطْفِكَ،
transliteration: wa h'amalat-neel-makhaafatu min-naqimatika a'laat-tamas-suki biu'r-wati a't'-fik
english_text: fear of Your vengeance has prompted me to cling to the handhold of Your tenderness!

arabic_text: وَما حَقُّ مَنِ اعْتَصَمَ بِحَبْلِكَ أَنْ يُخْذَلَ،
transliteration: wa maaaah'aq-qu mani aa'-tas'ama bih'ab-lika ay-yukh-d'al
english_text: It is not right for him who holds fast to Your cord to be abandoned,

arabic_text: وَلا يَلِيقُ بِمَنِ اسْتَجَارَ بِعِزِّكَ أَنْ يُسْلَمَ أَوْ يُهْمَلَ.
transliteration: wa laa yaleequ bimanis-tajaara bii'z-zika ay-yus-lama aw yuh-mal
english_text: nor proper for him who seeks the sanctuary of Your might to be surrendered or disregarded.

transliteration: ilaahee falaa tukh-linaa min h'imaayatik
english_text: My God, empty us not of Your defending,

transliteration: wa laa tua'-rinaa mir-ria'ayatik
english_text: strip us not of Your guarding,

transliteration: wa d'ud-naa a'm-mawaaridil-halakah
english_text: and protect us from the roads of destruction,

transliteration: fa in-naa bia'y-nika wa fee kanafika
english_text: for we are in Your eye and under Your wing!

arabic_text: وَلَكَ أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَهْلِ خاصَّتِكَ مِنْ مَلائِكَتِكَ،
transliteration: wa lak as-aluka b aih-li khaaas'-s'atika mim-malaaa-ikatika
english_text: I ask You by those whom You have singled out, Your angels

transliteration: was'-s'aalih'eena mim-baree-yatika
english_text: and the righteous among Your creatures,

arabic_text: أَنْ تَجْعَلَ عَلَيْنا واقِيَةً تُنْجِينا مِنَ الْهَلَكاتِ،
transliteration: an taj-a'la a'lay-naa waaqeeatan tunjeenaa minal-halakat
english_text: to assign over us a protector through which You will deliver us from destructions,

transliteration: wa tujan-nibunaa minal-aaafaat
english_text: turn aside from us blights,

transliteration: wa tukin-nunaa min dawaaheel-mus'eebaat
english_text: and hide us from the striking of great afflictions,

transliteration: wa an tunzila a'lay-naa min sakeenatik
english_text: to send down upon us some of Your tranquillity,

transliteration: wa an tughash-sheea wujoohanaa bi anwaari mah'ab-batik
english_text: to wrap our faces in the lights of love for You,

transliteration: wa an too-wiyanaaa ilaa shadeedi ruk-nik
english_text: to give us haven in Your strong pillar,
